\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 189-192 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R197-first-pass-words-from-chapters-189-192}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a brush and a razor.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item until; as long as, till then, so far, right away, late
  \item a valley, a zoo, a university, a college, a dwelling
  \item a tea house, a church, a gurdwara, a graveyard, a minaret
  \item but rather, perhaps, certainly, of course, regret; a pity
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Until; as long as? (\textbf{\ur{جب} \ur{تک}}, \emph{jab tak}.) Till then? (\textbf{\ur{تب} \ur{تک}}, \emph{tab tak}.) So far? (\textbf{\ur{ابھی} \ur{تک}}, \emph{abhī tak}.) Right away? (\textbf{\ur{اسی} \ur{وقت}}, \emph{isī vaqt}.) Late? (\textbf{\ur{دیر} \ur{سے}}, \emph{der se}.) A valley? (\textbf{\ur{وادی}}, \emph{vādī}.) A zoo? (\textbf{\ur{چڑیا} \ur{گھر}}, \emph{chiṛyā ghar}.) A university? (\textbf{\ur{یونیورسٹی}}, \emph{yūnīvarsiṭī}.) A college? (\textbf{\ur{کالج}}, \emph{kālij}.) A dwelling? (\textbf{\ur{مکان}}, \emph{makān}.) A tea house? (\textbf{\ur{چائے} \ur{خانہ}}, \emph{chāe khānā}.) A church? (\textbf{\ur{گرجا} \ur{گھر}}, \emph{girjā ghar}.) A gurdwara? (\textbf{\ur{گوردوارہ}}, \emph{gurdvārā}.) A graveyard? (\textbf{\ur{قبرستان}}, \emph{qabristān}.) A minaret? (\textbf{\ur{مینار}}, \emph{mīnār}.) But rather? (\textbf{\ur{بلکہ}}, \emph{balki}.) Perhaps? (\textbf{\ur{شاید}}, \emph{shāyad}.) Certainly? (\textbf{\ur{ضرور}}, \emph{zarūr}.) Of course? (\textbf{\ur{بے} \ur{شک}}, \emph{beshak}.) Regret; a pity? (\textbf{\ur{افسوس}}, \emph{afsos}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 193-197 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R197-second-pass-words-from-chapters-193-197}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for honest and cowardly.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item honest, cowardly, stingy, greedy, worried
  \item square, crooked, shallow, stale, spicy
  \item sky blue, suddenly, more, completely, careless
  \item restless, notorious, virtuous, youthful; a young person, modern
  \item a mat, shampoo, toothpaste, a brush, a razor
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Honest? (\textbf{\ur{ایماندار}}, \emph{imāndār}.) Cowardly? (\textbf{\ur{بزدل}}, \emph{buzdil}.) Stingy? (\textbf{\ur{کنجوس}}, \emph{kanjūs}.) Greedy? (\textbf{\ur{لالچی}}, \emph{lālchī}.) Worried? (\textbf{\ur{پریشان}}, \emph{pareshān}.) Square? (\textbf{\ur{چوکور}}, \emph{chaukor}.) Crooked? (\textbf{\ur{ٹیڑھا}}, \emph{ṭeṛhā}.) Shallow? (\textbf{\ur{اتھلا}}, \emph{uthlā}.) Stale? (\textbf{\ur{باسی}}, \emph{bāsī}.) Spicy? (\textbf{\ur{تیکھا}}, \emph{tīkhā}.) Sky blue? (\textbf{\ur{آسمانی}}, \emph{āsmānī}.) Suddenly? (\textbf{\ur{اچانک}}, \emph{achānak}.) More? (\textbf{\ur{زیادہ}}, \emph{zyādā}.) Completely? (\textbf{\ur{بالکل}}, \emph{bilkul}.) Careless? (\textbf{\ur{لاپرواہ}}, \emph{lāparvāh}.) Restless? (\textbf{\ur{بے} \ur{چین}}, \emph{bechain}.) Notorious? (\textbf{\ur{بدنام}}, \emph{badnām}.) Virtuous? (\textbf{\ur{نیک}}, \emph{nek}.) Youthful; a young person? (\textbf{\ur{نوجوان}}, \emph{naujavān}.) Modern? (\textbf{\ur{جدید}}, \emph{jadīd}.) A mat? (\textbf{\ur{چٹائی}}, \emph{chaṭāī}.) Shampoo? (\textbf{\ur{شیمپو}}, \emph{shaimpū}.) Toothpaste? (\textbf{\ur{ٹوتھ} \ur{پیسٹ}}, \emph{ṭūthpesṭ}.) A brush? (\textbf{\ur{برش}}, \emph{brash}.) A razor? (\textbf{\ur{استرا}}, \emph{ustarā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
